one_line_thought: 地図は、niche を薄くする。

axis_semantics.z_meaning: native GPS height above mean sea level on the same tracking event as x-y and timestamp
axis_semantics.claim_boundary: axis-resolved realized flight-state support conditional on the archived tracking design; not fundamental niche, occupancy, causal vertical preference, canopy height, or height above ground

z_discretization.rule: left_closed_right_open_except_last; negative and >=3200 m values remain in explicit tail bins; no clipping or winsorization
z_discretization.rationale: fixed physically interpretable multiplicative altitude bands anchored at sea level and 50 m; no empirical quantiles or outcome-adaptive cutpoints

numeric_qc.source_marked_outliers_sensitivity: exclude manually_marked_outlier only as a fixed sensitivity

whole_individual_split.algorithm: reuse exactly the structural split: sort identifiers by SHA256('odsp-n2-bat-v1|<individual>'); first ceil(0.25*n) sealed

horizontal_cell_mass.definition: for each model individual i, normalize its finite-height events in frozen primary eligible cells to total mass 1; compute that individual's cell-frequency vector q_i(x,y); P_model(x,y) is the arithmetic mean of q_i(x,y) over model individuals with at least one finite-height event in any frozen primary eligible cell

within_cell_vertical_distribution.definition: for each frozen primary eligible cell c and each model individual i with at least one finite-height event in c, count events in the primary fixed z bins, add Jeffreys pseudocount 0.5 to every z bin, normalize to p_i(z|c), then define P_model(z|c) as the arithmetic mean of p_i(z|c) over the model individuals represented in c

support_weighting.joint_support: define P_model(x,y,z)=P_model(x,y)*P_model(z|x,y) on frozen primary eligible cells and zero mass elsewhere; renormalize only for floating-point tolerance if necessary
support_weighting.sealed_scoring: each sealed individual contributes one equal-weight mean log-score gain over its own scored events; event count cannot weight one sealed individual more than the other
support_weighting.reason: prevent tracking duration, event count, or one intensively sampled bat from dominating niche thickness or answer-check

primary_estimand.support_state: P_model(x,y,z) on frozen primary eligible 5 km model-pool cells and primary fixed z bins
primary_estimand.information: H(Z|X,Y) in nats computed from the frozen individual-weighted P_model(x,y,z)
primary_estimand.local_map: axis_thickness_map effective vertical states per frozen supported primary x-y cell using P_model(z|x,y)
primary_estimand.projection_interpretation: H(Z|X,Y) is the vertical-state information discarded when z is marginalized from the declared x-y-z support representation
primary_estimand.reason_no_magnitude_threshold: thickness is an estimand to report, not a post-hoc pass/fail effect-size cutoff

model_distribution.conditional: P_model(z|x,y) is the equal-individual arithmetic mean of Jeffreys-smoothed per-individual within-cell z distributions defined in support_weighting
model_distribution.marginal_comparator: for each model individual with at least one finite-height event in frozen primary eligible cells, count all of that individual's eligible-cell events in the primary fixed z bins, add Jeffreys pseudocount 0.5 to every z bin, normalize to p_i(z), then define P_model(z) as the arithmetic mean of p_i(z) across those model individuals
model_distribution.smoothing_stage: Jeffreys additive pseudocount 0.5 is applied to each per-individual categorical z distribution before arithmetic averaging; do not add a second pseudocount after averaging

sealed_answer_check.scored_events: finite-height sealed events whose x-y cell is frozen primary-model eligible
sealed_answer_check.event_metric: log P_model(z|x,y) - log P_model(z) using the frozen model-only distributions
sealed_answer_check.per_individual_metric: arithmetic mean of the event metric within one sealed individual
sealed_answer_check.aggregate_metric: unweighted arithmetic mean of the two sealed-individual mean gains
sealed_answer_check.uncertainty: do not report a pseudo-precise bootstrap confidence interval from only two sealed individuals; report both individual gains, their equal-weight mean, and scored-event coverage

decision_categories.estimable_and_generalizing: finite-height QC passes, both sealed individuals meet scoring coverage, and both sealed-individual mean log-score gains are strictly > 0
decision_categories.estimable_but_generalization_mixed: finite-height QC and coverage pass, but the two sealed-individual gains are not both >0 and not both <=0
decision_categories.estimable_but_non_generalizing: finite-height QC and coverage pass and both sealed-individual gains are <= 0
decision_categories.empirical_thickness_answer_check_unavail: finite-height fraction or either sealed individual's scoring coverage fails under frozen rules

sealed_answer_check.primary_scientific_support_rule: only estimable_and_generalizing supports transferable x-y-resolved vertical-state structure in this empirical lane; descriptive H(Z|X,Y)>0 alone is not sufficient

secondary_reports.sealed_descriptive_H_Z_given_XY: may be reported under the same frozen bins/cells as descriptive replication, but cannot override the primary answer-check category
secondary_reports.grid_and_bin_sensitivities: report numerical estimates or not_evaluable status, but no sensitivity may replace or override the primary decision

terminal_categories.empirical_n2_thickness_generalizing: numeric QC passes and sealed answer-check is estimable_and_generalizing
terminal_categories.empirical_n2_thickness_generalization_mi: numeric QC passes and sealed answer-check is estimable_but_generalization_mixed
terminal_categories.empirical_n2_thickness_not_generalizing: numeric QC passes and sealed answer-check is estimable_but_non_generalizing
terminal_categories.empirical_n2_thickness_unavailable: numeric QC or sealed answer-check coverage is unavailable under frozen rules

do_not_claim: height above ground or canopy-relative height
